target_claim: The proof claims that an irreducible closed subspace admits two proper closed subsets whose union is the whole subspace.
source_quote:
By definition of [[Definition:Closed Set (Topology)|closed]] [[Definition:Irreducible Space|irreducible]] [[Definition:Topological Subspace|subspace]] there exists [[Definition:Proper Subset|proper]] [[Definition:Closed Set (Topology)|closed subsets]] $F_1, F_2$ of $F$:
:$F = F_1 \cup F_2$
:$F_1 \subsetneq F$
:$F_2 \subsetneq F$
